validation_boundaries: Real Python independent solver tests use analytic controls; they are not a comparison with a running Rust backend in this environment.
Chromium fixtures render actual new JSX with synthetic state and minimal hooks; not full Next/React hydration, network, GPU, or campaign tests.
Native backend, campaign, notebook and research ZIP integration acceptance is supplied in tests/discovery_runtime_smoke.py and Windows/Linux CI, but could not run without a Rust binary.
Compiler, dependency installation, PowerShell and live-provider tests remain native gates. No scientific novelty, validity, or publication acceptance is inferred from structural checks.
